senses.en: feeling pleased about something you or others did

ex.en: Her parents are proud of her speech.
ex.zh: 她父母为她的演讲感到自豪。

ex.en: A school can be proud of a garden and still admit who did the watering.
ex.zh: 学校可以为花园自豪，同时承认是谁浇的水。

tip: be proud of 后接名词或 doing。骄傲过头时 proud 含贬义，要看语境。

senses.en: money received from work or other sources

ex.en: Rent takes a large part of their income.
ex.zh: 房租占了他们收入的很大一部分。

ex.en: When food prices rise, low income leaves less money for books and clinic visits.
ex.zh: 食品涨价时，低收入会让书和看病的钱更少。

tip: income 可数或不可数都可以。

senses.en: easy to understand or do

ex.en: Please use simple words in the notice.
ex.zh: 通知里请用简单的词。

ex.en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。

tip: simple 的副词是 simply。

senses.en: not anything

ex.en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
ex.zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。

ex.en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
ex.zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。

tip: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

senses.en: until now, often in questions and negatives
but at the same time

ex.en: She has not finished the poster yet.
ex.zh: 她还没有完成海报。

ex.en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
ex.zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。

tip: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

senses.en: strong trust, or a religion

ex.en: She has faith in the team's hard work.
ex.zh: 她相信队伍的努力。

ex.en: Public rules should protect every faith without making one of them the school rule.
ex.zh: 公共规则应当保护每一种信仰，而不把其中一种变成校规。

tip: faith 可指对人的信任，也可指宗教信仰。

senses.en: to become smaller in amount
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: a spoken or written remark
to give an opinion

ex.en: She left a short comment under the article.
ex.zh: 她在文章下面留了一条短评。

ex.en: A rude comment online can follow a student longer than the lesson it interrupted.
ex.zh: 网上一句粗鲁的评论，可能比它打断的那节课跟学生更久。

tip: comment 作动词时，说 comment on something。

senses.en: the chance of something bad
to do something that may cause harm

ex.en: There is a risk of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午有下雨的风险。

ex.en: The risk of flooding rises when a town builds houses on the cheapest land beside a river.
ex.zh: 当城镇把房子建在河边最便宜的地上时，洪水风险会上升。

tip: risk doing 表示冒险做可能带来坏结果的事。

senses.en: existing in nature, or normal

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。

ex.en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
ex.zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。

tip: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

senses.en: a mistake
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have

ex.en: Please keep the door closed.
ex.zh: 请让门保持关着。

ex.en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
ex.zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。

tip: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

senses.en: on the side opposite the right

senses.zh: 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）
senses.en: past form of leave

ex.en: Turn left after the school gate.
ex.zh: 出校门后向左转。

ex.en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
ex.zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。

tip: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

senses.en: to move something into a place

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: If a city puts all new housing on the edge, workers spend hours travelling to jobs in the centre.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市把新住房都放在边缘，工人就要花数小时去市中心上班。

tip: put 的过去式和过去分词都是 put，不是 putted。

senses.en: to rescue, to avoid spending, or to keep

ex.en: Save your work before you close the computer.
ex.zh: 关电脑前先保存作业。

ex.en: Towns that save old trees save shade that new saplings cannot give for years.
ex.zh: 保住老树的城镇，也保住了新树苗多年内给不了的荫凉。

tip: save 表示拯救或节省，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: to fasten or join
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
ex.zh: 请把照片附在表格上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: used for a possibility that is not certain

ex.en: It might snow tonight, so take a coat.
ex.zh: 今晚可能会下雪，带件外套。

ex.en: A new subway line might help the centre while making outer villages feel even farther away.
ex.zh: 一条新地铁线可能方便市中心，同时让外围村庄感觉更远。

tip: might 比 may 语气更不确定，两者后面都接动词原形。

senses.en: a high opinion, or regard for someone's rights
to admire and treat well

ex.en: Students show respect by listening.
ex.zh: 学生用倾听来表示尊重。

ex.en: Respect for local knowledge means asking residents where the flood actually reached.
ex.zh: 尊重本地知识，意味着询问居民洪水实际淹到了哪里。

tip: respect 作动词直接接宾语：respect sb。

senses.en: the bottom support, or a main place
to use something as the starting point

ex.en: Trust is the base of the club.
ex.zh: 信任是这个社团的基础。

ex.en: A flood plan with no local base of volunteers will be slow on the first wet night.
ex.zh: 没有本地志愿者基础的防汛计划，会在第一个雨夜行动迟缓。

tip: be based on 表示以……为基础。base 作动词是“以……为根据”。

senses.en: in the direction of, or in relation to

ex.en: We walked towards the gate.
ex.zh: 我们朝校门走去。

ex.en: Attitudes towards night buses change when people have to use them themselves.
ex.zh: 当人们不得不自己去坐夜班公交时，他们对它的态度会改变。

tip: 英式常用 towards，美式常用 toward，意思相同。

senses.en: to keep safe from harm

ex.en: Trees protect the playground from the sun.
ex.zh: 树木保护操场不受日晒。

ex.en: Laws that protect a river also protect the drinking water of the next town.
ex.zh: 保护河流的法律，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。

col: protect sb from｜保护某人免受
tip: protect 后接宾语，再加 from 或 against。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay

ex.en: The hotel near the station is full.
ex.zh: 车站附近的旅馆满了。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill every hotel while ordinary rents rise for the rest of the year.
ex.zh: 大型体育赛事可以住满每家旅馆，同时让普通房租在这一年的其余时间上涨。

tip: hotel 是可数名词。

senses.en: clever, or neat and fashionable

ex.en: That was a smart way to save time.
ex.zh: 那是个省时间的聪明办法。

ex.en: A smart uniform does not tell a teacher who prepared and who copied.
ex.zh: 整齐时髦的校服并不能告诉老师谁做了准备、谁抄了作业。

tip: smart 可指聪明，也可指衣着整齐时髦。美式口语里很常见。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste water.
ex.zh: 我们浪费不起水。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: an edge, a face, or one of two groups

ex.en: Please write notes on the side of the page.
ex.zh: 请把笔记写在页边。

ex.en: Both sides of a noisy road need a safe crossing if children walk to school there.
ex.zh: 如果孩子从那里走路上学，嘈杂马路的两边都需要安全的过街处。

col: on the other side｜在另一边
tip: side 是名词；旁边用 beside 或 by the side of。

senses.en: pleasant to look at
fairly

ex.en: The pretty garden is behind the hall.
ex.zh: 漂亮的花园在大厅后面。

ex.en: A pretty river view does not mean the water is clean enough for children to play in.
ex.zh: 河景漂亮并不意味着水干净到可以让孩子玩。

tip: pretty 作副词表示“相当”，语气比 very 弱。

senses.en: easy to understand or see
to remove, or to become bright

ex.en: Please write a clear title.
ex.zh: 请写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: Clear signs at a junction matter more at night, when drivers and children share a narrow road.
ex.zh: 路口清楚的标志在夜里更重要，那时司机和孩子共用一条窄路。

tip: clear 作动词是“清除”或“放晴”。It is clear that...

senses.en: using numbers, or stored as computer data

ex.en: The digital clock in the hall is wrong.
ex.zh: 大厅里的数字钟不准。

ex.en: Digital notes are easy to share and easy to lose if nobody keeps a copy.
ex.zh: 数字笔记容易分享，如果没人留备份也容易丢失。

tip: digital 与 analogue 相对。不要和 traditional 的反义 modern 混用。

senses.en: a hard clear material, or a cup made of it

ex.en: There is a glass of water on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯水。

ex.en: Broken glass on a playground is a safety problem, not only a cleaning job.
ex.zh: 操场上的碎玻璃是安全问题，不只是打扫的事。

tip: glass 作材料不可数。a glass 是一只杯子。眼镜用复数 glasses。

senses.en: the group of people who govern a country or city

ex.en: The government plans to repair the old bridge.
ex.zh: 政府计划修缮那座旧桥。

ex.en: A local government that publishes its spending makes it easier for citizens to ask useful questions.
ex.zh: 公开支出的地方政府，让公民更容易提出有用的问题。

tip: government 作整体时谓语常用单数。

senses.en: one time, or at some time in the past
as soon as

ex.en: I have been to the museum only once.
ex.zh: 我只去过一次博物馆。

ex.en: Once a wetland is filled in for housing, the birds do not return just because a sign says they are welcome.
ex.zh: 一旦湿地被填平用来建房，鸟儿不会因为一块欢迎的牌子就回来。

tip: once 引导条件从句时表示“一旦”，主句常用将来或情态。

senses.en: just, or reasonably good
an outdoor sale or exhibition

ex.en: The rule is fair if it applies to everyone.
ex.zh: 如果规则适用于所有人，它就是公平的。

ex.en: A fair chance to learn includes a quiet room, not only an equal test paper.
ex.zh: 公平的学习机会包括一间安静的房间，而不只是一份相同的试卷。

tip: fair 作名词是“集市、义卖”。

senses.en: important; large
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem.
ex.zh: 交通是一个重大问题。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: a written message, or a sign in the alphabet

ex.en: I wrote a letter to my cousin.
ex.zh: 我给表哥写了一封信。

ex.en: A letter to the council should name the street and the problem, not only the feeling.
ex.zh: 给市政会的信应该写明街道和问题，而不只是情绪。

tip: letter 的两个常见义是信和字母。

senses.en: unpleasant, poor, or serious

ex.en: The weather was bad, so the match was delayed.
ex.zh: 天气不好，比赛推迟了。

ex.en: Bad air on the walk to school can harm children even when their classrooms are clean.
ex.zh: 即使教室很干净，上学路上的糟糕空气仍可能伤害孩子。

tip: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst，不是 more bad。

senses.en: familiar with something, or not new

ex.en: I am used to getting up early on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我习惯早起。

ex.en: A used textbook can be as useful as a new one if the notes in the margin are clear.
ex.zh: 如果页边的笔记清楚，旧课本可以和新的一样有用。

col: be used to do｜被用来做
tip: used to do 是过去常常；be used to doing 是习惯于。不要混用。

senses.en: a particular published form of a book or paper

ex.en: We use the new edition of the textbook.
ex.zh: 我们用这本教材的新版。

ex.en: The evening edition of the paper corrected a name that the morning edition had wrong.
ex.zh: 晚报更正了早报写错的一个名字。

tip: edition 是一版出版物。软件或文本的另一种形式也可用 version。

senses.en: the making of goods, or a branch of business

ex.en: The town grew around the steel industry.
ex.zh: 这个城镇是围绕钢铁工业发展起来的。

ex.en: An industry beside a river should pay for the water it dirties, not only for the jobs it creates.
ex.zh: 河边的工业应该为它弄脏的水付费，而不只为它创造的工作。

tip: industry 的复数是 industries。

senses.en: and not, used after a negative

ex.en: He cannot swim, nor can his brother.
ex.zh: 他不会游泳，他弟弟也不会。

ex.en: The hall has neither a ramp nor a clear sign, so some parents never come in.
ex.zh: 礼堂既没有坡道，也没有清楚的标志，所以有些家长从不进来。

tip: neither...nor 连接并列成分。nor 放在句首时，后面的句子常用倒装。or 已在排除的虚词里，nor 作为考纲词头保留。

senses.en: a person who controls a business or team

ex.en: The shop manager checked the list.
ex.zh: 店经理核对了清单。

ex.en: A hospital manager who walks the night ward sees problems a report can miss.
ex.zh: 走夜班病房的医院经理，能看到报告可能漏掉的问题。

tip: manager 是人；management 是管理这个工作。

senses.en: the top of the body, or the person in charge
to go towards, or to lead

ex.en: She nodded her head to show she understood.
ex.zh: 她点头表示听懂了。

ex.en: A club needs a head who listens, or the loudest member will decide everything.
ex.zh: 社团需要一个肯听意见的负责人，否则声音最大的人会决定一切。

col: from head to foot｜从头到脚
tip: head for 表示朝某地去。head 作动词是“前往”或“率领”。

senses.en: on the day before today
the day before today

ex.en: Yesterday we practised the play in the hall.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在大厅里排戏。

ex.en: A storm yesterday closed two roads, so some students arrived after the first lesson.
ex.zh: 昨天的暴风雨封了两条路，所以有些学生第一节课后才到。

tip: yesterday 前不用介词，不说 on yesterday。

senses.en: a thing that is not named

ex.en: There is something wrong with the clock.
ex.zh: 这只钟有点问题。

ex.en: Something as small as a leaked battery can pollute the soil around a school for years.
ex.zh: 一块泄漏的电池这样小的东西，也可能污染学校周围的土壤很多年。

tip: 形容词放在 something 后面：something important。

senses.en: without other people

ex.en: She walked home alone.
ex.zh: 她独自走回了家。

ex.en: A child should not wait alone for a late bus on a road without lights.
ex.zh: 孩子不该独自在没有灯的路上等晚点的公交。

tip: alone 强调独自；lonely 强调孤独的感觉。alone 不作定语放在名词前。

senses.en: to stop something from happening

ex.en: Wash your hands to prevent a cold from spreading.
ex.zh: 洗手以防止感冒传播。

ex.en: Street lights prevent some night accidents, and they do not replace a crossing.
ex.zh: 路灯能防止一些夜间事故，但不能代替斑马线。

col: prevent sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip: 固定搭配是 prevent somebody from doing something。

senses.en: to end an activity or prevent something
a halt, or a place where a bus stops

ex.en: Please stop talking when the bell rings.
ex.zh: 铃响时请停止讲话。

ex.en: Cities that stop cars from idling outside schools cut the fumes children breathe at the gate.
ex.zh: 禁止汽车在校门外怠速的城市，减少了孩子在门口吸入的废气。

col: stop sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip: stop doing 是停下正在做的事；stop to do 是停下来去做另一件事。

senses.en: the side that faces forward
at the front

ex.en: Please come to the front if you cannot see.
ex.zh: 如果看不见，请到前面来。

ex.en: Shops in front of a school affect what students buy more than a poster inside the classroom does.
ex.zh: 学校前面的商店对学生买什么的影响，大于教室里的一张海报。

tip: in front of 在外部前面；in the front of 在内部的前部。

senses.en: well known
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: This song sounds familiar.
ex.zh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉。

ex.en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
ex.zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: the dark part of the day

ex.en: I review new words at night.
ex.zh: 我在晚上复习生词。

ex.en: Bright signs at night may help shops, but they can also keep nearby residents awake.
ex.zh: 夜间明亮的招牌也许有助于商店，但也会让附近居民睡不着。

tip: at night 不加 the；on 加具体的某个夜晚，如 on Sunday night。

senses.en: to put a question, or to request

ex.en: Ask the teacher if you do not understand.
ex.zh: 不懂就问老师。

ex.en: Cities should ask residents where floods actually reach, not only where the map predicts them.
ex.zh: 城市应该询问居民洪水实际淹到哪里，而不只是看地图的预测。

col: ask sb to do｜请某人做
tip: ask sb sth 或 ask sb to do。ask 后不接 sb doing。

senses.en: a copy, a good example, or a design

ex.en: We built a model of the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个桥的模型。

ex.en: A role model in a textbook helps less than a neighbour who does the job the student hopes to learn.
ex.zh: 课本里的榜样，不如一个正在做学生想学的工作的邻居有用。

tip: model 作动词是“做模特”或“以……为榜样”。

senses.en: burning, or a destructive burning
to shoot, or to dismiss from a job

ex.en: We had a fire drill on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一我们进行了消防演习。

ex.en: A hillside fire can reach a village faster than a warning if the road out is narrow.
ex.zh: 如果出去的路很窄，山火到达村庄的速度可以快过警报。

tip: fire 作“火”时常不可数；一场火灾用 a fire。

senses.en: a girl or woman with the same parents

ex.en: My sister walks home with me.
ex.zh: 我姐姐和我一起走回家。

ex.en: A sister who leaves for the city may still call home, but the daily help is gone.
ex.zh: 去城市的姐妹也许仍会打电话回家，但日常的帮忙没有了。

tip: sister 的复数是 sisters。

senses.en: what is actually true

ex.en: The film is fun, but it is not reality.
ex.zh: 这部电影好看，但它不是现实。

ex.en: Budget reality returns when a school must choose between a new lab and repairing the roof.
ex.zh: 当学校必须在新实验室和修屋顶之间选择时，预算的现实就回来了。

tip: reality 通常不可数。in reality 用来纠正一种看起来相反的印象。

senses.en: a speed, a proportion, or a price

ex.en: The heart rate rises when you run.
ex.zh: 跑步时心率会上升。

ex.en: A high absence rate may show a bus problem, not only a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 高缺勤率可能说明公交有问题，而不只是缺乏兴趣。

col: at a rate of｜以……的速度
tip: rate 作动词是“评价”。

senses.en: the coldest season

ex.en: Winter here lasts from December to February.
ex.zh: 这里的冬天从十二月持续到二月。

ex.en: Schools in a long winter need heating plans that poor families can still afford.
ex.zh: 漫长冬天里的学校需要穷人家庭仍然负担得起的供暖方案。

tip: 季节前通常不用 the：in winter。特指某一年的冬天可以用 the winter of。

senses.en: a person who treats illness, or a holder of a doctorate

ex.en: The doctor asked him to rest for two days.
ex.zh: 医生让他休息两天。

ex.en: A school doctor can notice a hearing problem early, before it affects every lesson.
ex.zh: 校医可以早发现听力问题，免得它影响到每一节课。

tip: 称谓缩写是 Dr.，本库已有单独词条。博士和医生都可能用 doctor，要看语境。

senses.en: to be worthy of

ex.en: You deserve a rest after such hard work.
ex.zh: 这么辛苦之后你应得休息。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: of the mind

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: mental health matters as much as body health.
ex.zh: 心理健康与身体健康同样重要。

ex.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
ex.zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: a part of something

ex.en: Read the first section of the text.
ex.zh: 读课文的第一部分。

ex.en: The sports section of a newspaper rarely explains who pays for the new stadium.
ex.zh: 报纸的体育版很少解释新体育场的钱是谁出的。

tip: section 可指文章的一部分，也可指机构的部门。

senses.en: a group of things kept together

ex.en: The library has a collection of old maps.
ex.zh: 图书馆收藏了一批旧地图。

ex.en: A collection of photos taken each spring can show how a river changes.
ex.zh: 每年春天拍摄的一组照片，可以展示一条河如何变化。

tip: collection 是可数名词。

senses.en: a person who studies

ex.en: Every student has a library card.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有借书证。

ex.en: A student who works nights to pay rent may still care deeply about the class.
ex.zh: 为付房租上夜班的学生，仍然可能非常在意这门课。

tip: student 是可数名词。

senses.en: the reflexive form of you

ex.en: Please help yourself to the fruit.
ex.zh: 请随便吃水果。

ex.en: You should ask yourself who benefits before you share a story that sounds too perfect.
ex.zh: 在转发一个听起来过于完美的故事之前，你应该问问自己谁从中获益。

tip: 对多人用 yourselves。

senses.en: the amount of money something costs

ex.en: The price of the ticket is twenty yuan.
ex.zh: 票价是二十元。

ex.en: A low ticket price means little if the bus never reaches the villages that need it.
ex.zh: 如果公交根本到不了需要它的村子，低票价也没什么意义。

col: at a price of｜以……的价格
tip: price 是卖方标出的价格；cost 常指买方付出的代价。

senses.en: to be good for
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: Exercise can benefit both body and mind.
ex.zh: 锻炼有益于身心。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: a being believed to control nature or life

ex.en: In the story, the villagers thanked the god of the river.
ex.zh: 故事里，村民感谢河神。

ex.en: Ancient myths about a god of rain show how closely people once tied weather to survival.
ex.zh: 古代关于雨神的神话表明，人们曾经把天气和生存联系得多么紧密。

tip: god 指神灵；God 大写时常特指基督教等宗教中的上帝。

senses.en: a place where legal cases are heard, or a sports ground

ex.en: The tennis court is behind the gym.
ex.zh: 网球场在体育馆后面。

ex.en: A court that takes years to hear a simple case leaves families waiting for a decision.
ex.zh: 审理一件简单案件要花数年的法院，会让家庭一直等一个决定。

tip: court 既可指法庭也可指球场，要看搭配。

senses.en: done for only part of the usual working time

ex.en: She has a part-time job at the library.
ex.zh: 她在图书馆有一份兼职。

ex.en: Part-time jobs can teach responsibility, but they should not replace the sleep teenagers still need.
ex.zh: 兼职可以培养责任感，但不该取代青少年仍然需要的睡眠。

tip: part-time 作定语时通常加连字符；作状语有时写成 part time。

senses.en: coming after all others, or most recent
to continue for a period of time

ex.en: I sat in the last row during the talk.
ex.zh: 讲座时我坐在最后一排。

ex.en: Last year's flood still shapes where the town is willing to build new houses.
ex.zh: 去年的洪水仍然影响着这座城镇愿意在哪里建新房。

col: the last but not least｜最后但同样重要
tip: last 作动词是“持续”。过去式和过去分词仍是 last。

senses.en: to pay attention to sound

ex.en: Listen to the recording twice.
ex.zh: 把录音听两遍。

ex.en: Planners who listen to night-shift workers hear problems a daytime meeting never raises.
ex.zh: 倾听夜班工人的规划者，会听到白天的会议从不提出的问题。

tip: listen 是不及物动词，必须加 to 再接宾语。

senses.en: having little money, or not good

ex.en: The recording quality is poor.
ex.zh: 录音质量很差。

ex.en: Poor families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，贫穷家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: the poor 表示穷人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: the activity of reading

ex.en: Quiet reading starts at eight.
ex.zh: 安静阅读八点开始。

ex.en: Reading with an adult at home helps a child more than an extra worksheet.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人陪着阅读，比多一张练习纸更有帮助。

tip: reading 作“阅读”时常不可数。

senses.en: the star that gives the earth light

ex.en: The sun was hot at noon.
ex.zh: 中午太阳很晒。

ex.en: Shade from trees matters most when the sun is high and the walk to school is long.
ex.zh: 当太阳高、上学的路又长时，树荫最为重要。

tip: the sun 通常加 the。

senses.en: a person who believes in Christianity
of Christianity

ex.en: The guide said this church is still used by local Christians.
ex.zh: 导游说这座教堂仍供当地基督徒使用。

ex.en: A history lesson about Christian festivals should also explain who does not celebrate them.
ex.zh: 关于基督教节日的历史课，也应当说明谁不过这些节日。

tip: Christian 作名词和形容词都要大写。

senses.en: the reason for doing something

ex.en: The purpose of the survey is to plan lunch.
ex.zh: 这次调查的目的是安排午餐。

ex.en: A rule without a clear purpose is hard to defend when students ask why it exists.
ex.zh: 没有明确目的的规定，在学生追问它为什么存在时很难辩护。

tip: on purpose 是故意，反义是 by accident。

senses.en: in the middle, or most important

ex.en: The central library is near the station.
ex.zh: 中心图书馆在车站附近。

ex.en: Central heating in a school matters in a town where winter lasts five months.
ex.zh: 在冬天长达五个月的城镇，学校的集中供暖很重要。

tip: central 是形容词；centre / center 是名词。

senses.en: a person who directs a film or an organisation

ex.en: The director of the club explained the plan.
ex.zh: 社团负责人解释了计划。

ex.en: A hospital director who never walks the night ward may miss what the staff already know.
ex.zh: 从不走夜班病房的医院主任，可能会错过员工已经知道的事。

tip: director 是人；direction 是方向或指导。

senses.en: a planned set of actions

ex.en: The school started a campaign to save water.
ex.zh: 学校开展了节水运动。

ex.en: A campaign against litter fails if the bins are farther away than the habit of dropping rubbish.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶比随手扔垃圾的习惯更远，反垃圾运动就会失败。

tip: campaign 作动词是“参加运动”。

senses.en: the season after winter, a coil, or a source of water

ex.en: We plant flowers in spring.
ex.zh: 我们在春天种花。

ex.en: A spring of clean water can matter more to a village than a new sign at the roadside.
ex.zh: 一口干净的泉对村子的意义，可以大于路边一块新牌子。

tip: 季节前用 in spring，通常不加 the。spring 的三个义靠搭配区分。

senses.en: past experience or setting
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her family background shaped her views.
ex.zh: 她的家庭背景塑造了她的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: straight; clear
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: Take the direct route home.
ex.zh: 走直接回家的路。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: fighting between countries or groups

ex.en: The history class discussed the cost of war.
ex.zh: 历史课讨论了战争的代价。

ex.en: After a war, schools are often rebuilt later than roads, though children need them first.
ex.zh: 战争之后，学校的重建常常晚于道路，尽管孩子最先需要的是学校。

tip: war 前常用 in：in the war。

senses.en: teaching and learning

ex.en: Public education should not depend on a family's income.
ex.zh: 公共教育不该取决于一个家庭的收入。

ex.en: Education about floods is useful only when it includes the streets children actually use.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的教育，只有包含孩子真正走的那些街时才有用。

tip: education 不可数。

senses.en: a group of musicians, or a strip

ex.en: The school band will play tonight.
ex.zh: 学校乐队今晚演出。

ex.en: A band playing in the square should keep a volume that lets people talk.
ex.zh: 在广场演奏的乐队应该把音量保持在人们仍能交谈的程度。

tip: band 也可指橡皮筋或波段，要看搭配。

senses.en: the direction where the sun rises
in or towards the east

ex.en: The sun rises in the east.
ex.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

ex.en: Towns in the east of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
ex.zh: 该地区东部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。

tip: eastern 是形容词。

senses.en: a device for taking photographs or video

ex.en: Leave the camera in the bag during the test.
ex.zh: 考试时把相机留在包里。

ex.en: A camera at the school gate can make parents feel safer, and it also records ordinary children every day.
ex.zh: 校门口的摄像头能让家长更安心，它也会每天拍下普通的孩子。

tip: camera 重音在第一音节。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: The girl by the window is our monitor.
ex.zh: 窗边的女孩是我们的班长。

ex.en: A girl who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work, not only hear that it is possible.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女孩，应该看到有女性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是可能的。

tip: girl 的复数是 girls。

senses.en: a reply, or a solution
to reply

ex.en: Write the answer on the line.
ex.zh: 把答案写在横线上。

ex.en: An easy answer to traffic is another lane, but that often brings more cars.
ex.zh: 交通的简单答案是再加一条车道，但这常常带来更多汽车。

col: in answer to｜作为对……的回答
tip: the answer to a question，介词用 to，不用 of。

senses.en: a row, a long mark, or a queue

ex.en: Please stand in line for the tickets.
ex.zh: 请排队买票。

ex.en: A new metro line helps the centre, but outer towns still need buses to reach the first station.
ex.zh: 新地铁线方便市中心，但外围城镇仍需要公交才能到第一站。

tip: 排队英式常用 queue，美式常用 line。online 是一个词，表示“在线”。

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe

ex.en: The helmet is for your protection.
ex.zh: 头盔是用来保护你的。

ex.en: Legal protection for a river fails if nobody checks the factories along it.
ex.zh: 如果没人检查沿河工厂，对河流的法律保护就会落空。

col: under the protection of｜在……的保护下
tip: protection 通常不可数。具体的保护措施有时可用复数。

senses.en: the entrance to a room or building

ex.en: Please close the door quietly.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门。

ex.en: A shop door that opens onto a pavement full of cars is hard for a child to use.
ex.zh: 开向停满汽车的人行道的店门，孩子很难使用。

tip: answer the door 表示去开门。

senses.en: in or of the east

ex.en: The eastern sky was already bright.
ex.zh: 东方的天空已经亮了。

ex.en: Eastern provinces that share one river have to share the news of a flood as well.
ex.zh: 共用一条河的东部省份，也必须共享洪水的消息。

tip: eastern 是形容词。名词用 east。

senses.en: a way of doing or making something

ex.en: Each student has a different writing style.
ex.zh: 每个学生的写作风格不同。

ex.en: A building style that ignores local rain will leak in the first storm.
ex.zh: 忽视本地雨水的建筑风格，会在第一场暴风雨里漏水。

tip: lifestyle 常写作一个词。

senses.en: past tense of find
to start an organisation

ex.en: We found a quiet corner in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到一个安静的角落。

ex.en: Archaeologists found tools that show people cooked together long before cities existed.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现的工具表明，早在城市出现之前，人们就一起做饭了。

tip: find 的过去式是 found。表示“建立”时 founded 才是过去式，不要混用。

senses.en: stored information, or the best result so far
to write down or store sound

ex.en: Keep a record of the books you borrow.
ex.zh: 把你借的书记下来。

ex.en: A temperature record means little if the sensor sits in the sun beside a car park.
ex.zh: 如果传感器放在停车场旁边的太阳下，气温记录就没什么意义。

tip: record 作名词重音常在前；作动词“记录”时重音常在后。

senses.en: a part of a building, or space for something

ex.en: The music room is on the second floor.
ex.zh: 音乐教室在二楼。

ex.en: There is little room for a safe pavement if cars are allowed to park on both sides.
ex.zh: 如果允许汽车停在两边，就几乎没有空间做安全的人行道。

tip: room 表示空间时不可数：no room for。表示房间时可数。

senses.en: a break, or what remains
to stop activity for a while

ex.en: We had a short rest after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完后我们休息了一小会儿。

ex.en: The rest of the class waited outside while two students helped the teacher carry the maps.
ex.zh: 其余同学在外面等，两名学生帮老师搬地图。

tip: the rest of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

senses.en: to make unclear or mixed up
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: Too many choices may confuse buyers.
ex.zh: 选择太多可能让买家困惑。

ex.en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
ex.zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a person

ex.en: Every human being needs clean water.
ex.zh: 每个人都需要干净的水。

ex.en: A human being waiting for a bus in the dark is not a traffic statistic; the street should be lit.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中等公交的人不是一个交通统计数字；街道应该有灯。

tip: human being 比 human 更强调“人”这一完整说法，可数。

senses.en: attracted to people of the same sex; in older texts, cheerful

ex.en: In that old poem, gay means cheerful.
ex.zh: 在那首旧诗里，gay 的意思是快乐的。

ex.en: A school rule is fair only if gay students are treated with the same respect as everyone else.
ex.zh: 只有当同性恋学生和其他人得到同样的尊重时，校规才算公平。

col: gay and lesbian｜男女同性恋者
tip: 现代英语里 gay 主要指同性恋。旧诗文里它还可以表示快乐，阅读时要看年代。
